lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca2Bi6Se8 (reduced formula CaBi3(Se2)2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Ca centers as octahedrally coordinated by six Se atoms (2.6644–2.6786 Å) and Bi centers as tetrahedrally coordinated by four Se atoms (2.6306–2.6445 Å); Se centers show two- or three-coordinate environments. The resulting geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal edge-sharing between Ca octahedra and Bi tetrahedra, with corner-sharing also observed between Bi tetrahedra and between Ca octahedra.
